title: Six Winters and One Short Thread
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：fabric　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fabric 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 my aunt ① chose a fabric that no tailor in the town would have cut, and she said the choosing was the whole of the winter. The ② fabric, meaning the cloth itself and not the coat, ran six winters and stayed uncut in the book; a fabric, she said, is the only thing in a town that is judged by how long it is left uncut.

Every ③ fabric in that town had the same short thread beside it, and the ④ fabric at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the wedding and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A fabric, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to cut; my aunt said the cutting is the part that fills six winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the fabric was the whole of the building, meaning the structure and not the cloth. The ⑥ fabric, meaning the structure and not any of that, is the only thing in a building that everybody waits for and nobody cuts; fabric, he said, is either something you choose or the only word that means both cloth and a structure. He said the structure is the part they remember.

By 1958 the ⑦ fabric had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short thread. The ⑧ fabric of the whole thing, my aunt wrote in January, was one town and six winters of cutting; fabric, she said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to cut. She said the cutting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ fabric I remember is the one cut in the list, which closed in 1960 and is still described as the quietest in the town. A ⑩ fabric, my mother said in 1962, is the only one that improves by being cut; every fabric, she said, is a structure that has agreed to look like a piece of cloth. She said the structure was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 布料；织物（指镇上每一块旁边的那一块）
B. n. 布料（指那一块本身，与成衣相对）
C. 固定搭配：choose a fabric 挑一块布料
D. n. 布料（指留给婚礼的那一块）
E. n. 布料（抽象总称，指一座镇子上的选料之事）
F. n. 布料（指清单上写到、被裁的那一块）
G. n. 结构；构造（指一栋楼里人人都等却无人裁剪的那样东西）
H. n. 结构（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人裁剪的那样东西）

items.q: chose a fabric that no tailor in the town would have cut

the fabric at the far side

answers.why: choose a fabric 意为“挑一块布料”，1952 年姑姑挑了一块镇上没有一位裁缝肯裁的布料。
fabric 意为“布料”，指那一块本身而不是成衣，它经过了六个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
fabric 意为“布料”，指镇上每一块旁边的那一块，每一块旁边都有同一根短短的线。
fabric 意为“布料”，指留给婚礼的那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
fabric 意为“结构、构造”，指一栋楼里人人都等却无人裁剪的那样东西，叔叔说这个结构就是那栋楼的全部。
fabric 意为“结构”，指人人都等却无人裁剪的那样东西而不是那一块布料，是楼里人人都等、却无人裁剪的东西。
fabric 意为“布料”，指清单上写到、被裁的那一块，到 1958 年这一块成了清单里的一行。
fabric 意为“布料”，姑姑一月写道，整件事的选料之事是一座镇子和六个冬天的裁剪。
fabric 意为“布料”，我记得的是清单上裁的那一块，1960 年结束了，至今仍被说成镇上最安静的一块。
fabric 为抽象总称，母亲 1962 年说，一块布料是唯一会因为被好好裁剪而变得更好的东西。
